mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; trazodone is a serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor (SARI) while tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI, creating risk for serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; allow minimum 14-day washout after discontinuing tranylcypromine before initiating trazodone, or vice versa.
